recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12212 unless a future work group decision changes ServiceRequest performer or the ServiceRequest code/definition model.
issue_request: FHIR-12212 was a Published Patient Care change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked that ReferralRequest.recipient allow Reference(HealthcareService | Practitioner | Organization) and that HealthcareService be removed from ReferralRequest.definition.
initial_application: SVN-derived commit e6bb3b754b6b4790aed43bf8ac08422c794bfe6e explicitly mentioned #12212 and changed source/referralrequest/referralrequest-spreadsheet.sheet.txt so ReferralRequest.definition no longer referenced HealthcareService and ReferralRequest.recipient did reference HealthcareService.
additional_context: ReferralRequest is retired from the current build and source/fhir.ini records that ReferralRequest became ServiceRequest. ServiceRequest and HealthcareService are active resources. The current ServiceRequest.performer element carries the old request-recipient semantics via alias and target profiles, while the current code/definition representation allows ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition but not HealthcareService. A bounded Jira/Zulip/Confluence search found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active source already preserves both halves of the accepted Jira resolution after the ServiceRequest refactor.

evidence_items.learned: The discussion is consistent with treating ServiceRequest.performer as the successor to ReferralRequest.recipient and does not conflict with the no-change conclusion.
